Compile a list of documented dates of HIV care (labs and optionally care_nolab and/or ARV use)

Source: R/get_care_dts.R
get_care_dts.Rd

Compile a list of documented dates of HIV care (labs and optionally care_nolab and/or ARV use)

Usage

get_care_dts(
  incl_care_nolab = TRUE,
  incl_ARV_dts = TRUE,
  excl_care_before_dx = TRUE,
  care_dt..to = "15",
  care_dt....to = "0630",
  cache = "use"
)

Arguments

incl_care_nolab

Logical value specifying whether to include care_nolab dates

incl_ARV_dts

Logical value specifying whether to include documented dates of ARV use

excl_care_before_dx

Logical value specifying whether to drop care dates earlier than the earliest date of HIV diagnosis

care_dt..to

Two-digit (zero-padded, as needed) character value specifying the day to impute for dates of care, where missing. Defaults to '15'

care_dt....to

Four-digit (zero-padded, as needed) character value specifying the month+day to impute for dates of care, where missing. Defaults to '0630'

cache

Whether to use or overwrite cached results. Must be one of 'use' (the default), 'overwrite', or 'ignore'. If cache = 'use' (the default) and a dataset was generated by a previous call to this function using the same parameters and the same eHARS data and was cached, the cached dataset is returned, otherwise a dataset is derived and cached. If cache = 'overwrite', a dataset is (re-)derived and (re-)cached, overwriting any existing analogous dataset in the cache. If cache = 'ignore', a dataset is re-derived but not (re-)cached.

Value

A data.frame unique by stateno + care_dt_char (i.e., character value stored in lab.sample_dt / care_nolab_dt from the observation dataset / arv_prophylaxis.drug_start_dt / arv_prophylaxis.drug_last_use_dt). Contains variables care_dt (Date), care_type (1+ of: 'VL', 'CD4 cnt', 'CD4 pct', 'care_nolab (doc)', 'care_nolab (self-rpt)', 'drug_start_dt', 'drug_last_use_dt'), first_enter_dt (Date; earliest enter_dt for any document with this stateno + care_dt_char), document_uid (for documents with this stateno + care_dt_char, by care_type), and facility (for lab documents with this stateno + care_dt_char).

Details

The cached dataset is stored in the "/Derived" subdirectory of the date-specific folder containing the eHARS datasets. If no such directory exists when this function is called, it creates it.

Examples

care_dts <- get_care_dts()
#> Checking if //kc/dph/prevention/hiv/Epi/EXTRA SPACE/eHARS/Full eHARS/Archive/NA/derived/get_care_dts__incl_care_nolab_TRUE__incl_ARV_dts_TRUE__excl_care_before_dx_TRUE__care_dt..to_15__care_dt....to_0630.rds already exists...
#> Error: '//kc/dph/prevention/hiv/Epi/EXTRA SPACE/eHARS/Full eHARS/Archive/NA/document_sas7bdat/lab.sas7bdat' does not exist.
